rationale: Papers 2005.12164 and 2103.07786 provide evidence supporting magnetars as potential sources of FRBs, with 2005.12164 reporting an X-ray burst coincident with a radio burst from a Galactic magnetar. Paper 2409.06056 discusses an extragalactic magnetar giant flare, further supporting the magnetar hypothesis. These findings contribute substantive evidence but do not fully settle the question.
